text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text: Dear Mom and Dad, Today's the first day of summer camp! …But there's definitely something up with City.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text: She's so strong and cool—the perfect Umamusume. I didn't think there was anything someone like me could do to help her…

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text: But then my trainer was wondering if she was really as perfect as I thought, which reminded me of how Harp Alpha looked at the Osaka Hai…

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text: I don't know if it's my place to check on her, but I'm hoping to talk to City when I get a chance.
